One robot. An open engine. OhhO Robotics is Varun Vaidhiya, building in the UK. The robot on the bench is OmniBot: a Yahboom mecanum base, an SO-101 arm with Feetech STS3215 servos, a Raspberry Pi 5, and a Meta Quest 3 for teleop. What works today The engine can talk to that base, run a simulator with no hardware attached, and record arm and base motion for later training. The website consoles are interactive demos with simulated data, except where a page says a piece is shipped. There is no customer list, no staff, and no fleet. If you want to try the public code, start from the OmniBot repository. If you want to talk, email varun@ohho-robotics.com. O hh O ™ Open-Source Robots, First.
